index_after.diagnosis: Index changed during nominally read-only probes; no attribution yet. Probe timing variability is confounded and preserved.

attribution: The requested git diff --name-only probe in installed Git2.43.0 refreshed the stat cache despite GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0. Its completion aligns with index mtime; isolated fixture reproduces this behavior.
consequence: Later fast timings use refreshed Linux stat metadata; they are not evidence that the unchanged30-second guard is reliably fixed.
future_read_only_diff_policy: Use a per-invocation diff.autoRefreshIndex=false override for review/audit commands. No persistent config mutation. Runtime precheck itself uses status, not diff.
